verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://help.thoropass.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured index of help-center articles. Its contents are also cited directly as a source (docs-14), and help articles are available as markdown (.md) versions an agent can ingest, such as the MCP server connection guide. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs effectively, and agent-oriented developer/API documentation (e.g., llms-full.txt) beyond the end-user help center.
